2608.18681.title: Learning What to Fail On: Failure-Mode Contextual Bandits for Adversarial Data Curation
2608.18681.paper_summary: We introduce a failure-aware adversarial retrieval-augmented framework for improving robustness in natural language understanding. Rather than selecting synthetic examples with a fixed reward threshold, our method formulates adversarial data curation as a failure-mode contextual bandit problem. Candidate examples are generated with retrieval-augmented prompting, filtered by the current target model, automatically validated by an LLM judge ensemble, and clustered into recurring failure modes. A stochastic policy then selects which failure modes to sample for retraining, and is updated using validation-based reward that balances robustness gains, forgetting, and data cost. This makes the data curator itself the learning agent, enabling adaptive selection of the most useful model failures across training rounds. On standard benchmarks, our approach improves RoBERTa-base accuracy from 88.48% to 92.60% on SNLI, from 75.04% to 80.95% on ANLI, and from 54.67% to 71.99% on MultiNLI, while consistently outperforming prior adversarial augmentation methods. We further demonstrate transfer to FEVER fact verification, achieving up to 79.86\% FEVER score and 82.45\% accuracy with RoBERTa-large. Finally, we provide a theoretical interpretation showing that, under stated assumptions, failure-mode sampling can reduce shortcut-aligned gradient contributions while inducing bounded distributional drift. By combining retrieval, automated validation, contextual-bandit failure selection, and controlled adversarial retraining, our framework enables scalable robustness improvement without additional human annotation.
2608.18681.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了一種失敗感知的對抗檢索增強框架，以提高自然語言理解的穩健性。<lb/>我們的方法並不是選擇具有固定獎勵閾值的合成示例，而是將對抗數據策展形式化為一個失敗模式上下文強盜問題。<lb/>候選示例通過檢索增強提示生成，經當前目標模型過濾，並由大型語言模型評判集自動驗證，然後聚類為重複的失敗模式。<lb/>隨後，隨機策略選擇哪些失敗模式進行重訓，並使用基於驗證的獎勵進行更新，該獎勵平衡了穩健性增益、遺忘和數據成本。<lb/>這使得數據策展者本身成為學習代理，能夠在訓練回合中自適應選擇最有用的模型失敗。<lb/>在標準基準測試中，我們的方法將RoBERTa-base的準確率從88.48%提高到92.60%（SNLI），從75.04%提高到80.95%（ANLI），以及從54.67%提高到71.99%（MultiNLI），同時持續超越之前的對抗增強方法。<lb/>我們進一步展示了在FEVER事實驗證中的轉移，使用RoBERTa-large達到79.86%的FEVER分數和82.45%的準確率。<lb/>最後，我們提供了一個理論解釋，顯示在所述假設下，失敗模式採樣可以減少快捷對齊的梯度貢獻，同時引起有界的分佈漂移。<lb/>通過結合檢索、自動驗證、上下文強盜失敗選擇和受控對抗重訓，我們的框架實現了可擴展的穩健性改善，而無需額外的人類標註。
